goals.name: Mover Promotion Framework — First Cohort Live
goals.assessment: Substantial forward motion 8/19–8/20: Decision #16 (PTL→Junior Lead threshold) resolved — 400 hrs as lead or 80%+ led over 2 back-to-back pay periods, pulled from existing pay docs. Decision #18 (damages attribution) resolved — Cameron + Paul's compromise (team/job-level governs bonus + gates, individual fault stays coaching-only) with six amendments closing the design gaps. New Decision #19 locked (no grandfathering on launch). The HQ itself got a major upgrade: ladder table restructured into paired Standard/Fast Track columns and made interactively editable, two new tabs added (Decision History, How It Works — plain-language mechanics for BMs and movers), and a full visual restyle to match the mover-pay-premium page's look. Revised 8/21: Paul pushed back on Decision #18's attorney-confirm framing (no attorney gate needed — TX right-to-work, damages can stand alone as a termination reason for gross negligence or a documented pattern); Anne agreed same day. HQ card and evidence bar updated to match. Still blocked on the same paused backtest as Goal 2, plus the cadence conflict and #17.

#17 (coaching-trigger automation for damages) still unratified by Anne + Cameron
Evaluation cadence unresolved: monthly (current operating assumption) vs. the 7/3-locked biweekly — Paul's to resolve per the 8/20 damage-attribution brief

goals.green: Framework locked — damages resolved per Cameron's 7/30 ruling (in the promotion gate AND the bonus, not folded into the 100-point score), cadence and remaining HQ items ratified, published to branches by Oct 1.
goals.superGreen: Green + at least one real mover promoted under the locked framework by Oct 1.
